usage: The word 小時 (siu2 si4) is used to measure time durations, equivalent to an hour in English.
It is a noun and typically follows a number to indicate quantity, like 'two hours' or 'three hours'.
In questions, it can be used to ask about the length of time, for example, 'How many hours?'
To express fractions of an hour, 小時 can be combined with other time words, such as 'half an hour'.
It is often paired with verbs related to time, such as 'work', 'wait', or 'drive'.
